title: fix(csghub): honor the configured accounting port

files.patch:
@@ -111,3 +111,17 @@ tests:
       - equal:
           path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].image
           value: "registry.opencsg.com/opencsghq/csghub-server:v2.6.0-ee"
+
+  - it: uses the configured accounting port
+    template: csghub/accounting/deployment.yaml
+    set:
+      accounting:
+        service:
+          port: 18086
+    asserts:
+      - equal:
+          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].ports[0].containerPort
+          value: 18086
+      - equal:
+          path: spec.template.spec.containers[0].livenessProbe.tcpSocket.port
+          value: 18086

@@ -64,3 +64,17 @@ tests:
       - equal:
           path: spec.ports[1].name
           value: "payment"
+
+  - it: uses the configured accounting port
+    template: csghub/accounting/service.yaml
+    set:
+      accounting:
+        service:
+          port: 18086
+    asserts:
+      - equal:
+          path: spec.ports[0].port
+          value: 18086
+      - equal:
+          path: spec.ports[0].targetPort
+          value: 18086
